blocks.text: SAN FRANCISCO, Agusan del Sur – A non-commissioned police officer stationed in Surigao del Sur was named the country’s top investigator for women and children’s protection cases during a national summit in Zamboanga City, regional police officials said on Thursday. Chief Master Sergeant Christine Intano of the Carrascal Municipal Police Station received the Outstanding Senior Women and Children Protection Desk (WCPD) Police Non-Commissioned Officer (PNCO) of the Year 2026 award during the 14th Philippine National Police (PNP) National Biennial Summit of Women in Community Policing, held from Oct. 26 to 28 at the Garden Orchid Hotel.
